summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 requested behaviours on /demo-trade against the user's VPS backend (api.binaryfundglobal.com). Registered a fresh trader via VPS /api/auth/register, seeded localStorage bfg_token+bfg_user, loaded /demo-trade at 1920x800. All three requested behaviours PASS.

verified_behaviours.item: Lock icon on asset tab removed
verified_behaviours.result: PASS - no element with data-testid tab-lock-* exists before or during a running demo trade. After clicking UP the trade badge appears on the chart ($1.00 countdown) and Trades count = 1, but the EURUSD_OTC tab shows only the flag icon + name with no lock. close-tab-<SYM> button is correctly hidden while tabHasOpenTrades is true, preventing tab removal without adding a lock UI.

verified_behaviours.item: Price-axis cursor stays ns-resize on hover
verified_behaviours.result: PASS - getComputedStyle on element under pointer inside the right ~60px strip returns 'ns-resize'; moving to the chart body returns 'auto'.

verified_behaviours.item: Drag UP on price scale does NOT zoom candles bigger
verified_behaviours.result: PASS - series-canvas non-transparent pixel count: before-drag=47688, after drag-UP=47608 (delta -0.17%, i.e. bounded by PRICE_MARGIN_BASE 0.1). Never exceeded default fitted size.

verified_behaviours.item: Drag DOWN on price scale compresses candles
verified_behaviours.result: PASS - after dragging down (near PRICE_MARGIN_MAX 0.42) non-empty pixels dropped 47688 -> 10418 (-78%). Subsequent drag UP restored to 47568 (~default, not larger than baseline).

verified_behaviours.item: Chart does not drift vertically while scaling
verified_behaviours.result: PASS - visible price range grid labels stayed centered around the same band across drag states (screenshots loaded.png, during_trade.png). Margins are applied symmetrically top+bottom in onAxisMove so scaling stays vertically centered.

verified_behaviours.item: No console errors on trade page
verified_behaviours.result: PASS - only benign warnings observed (logo.png preload hint, Canvas2D willReadFrequently hint from our own test's getImageData, one WS reconnect warning during initial connect). No JS errors, chart streams candles from VPS socket.

critical_code_review_comments: TradeChart.jsx onAxisHover attaches 'cursor: ns-resize' to whatever element the pointer lands on (via inline !important) but only cleans it up when the pointer leaves the wrapper or hovers a different element - if pointerleave fires with cursorEl still set to an off-axis element you're safe, but rapid axis->pane transitions inside the same target could leave the cursor sticky. Consider clearing on every onAxisHover call whose inAxis is false (already done) and additionally when pointer re-enters the pane strictly left of the axis. Verified working in practice for our test.

TradeChart.jsx clampLoop is a continuous requestAnimationFrame running for the chart's entire lifetime; combined with the other RAF loops (badges, results, live-price) that is 4 always-on RAFs. Consider suspending clampLoop when document.hidden.
DemoTrade.jsx - useEffect for socket has empty dep array with eslint-disable but references token/pushResult; if token rotates the socket won't re-auth. Not in scope of these 3 changes though.

seed_data_creation: One demo trader account registered on VPS and one demo UP trade placed on EURUSD_OTC to verify no-lock behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local backend is intentionally stopped; never start it. All API + socket traffic goes to https://api.binaryfundglobal.com. Login route requires email 2FA - always use POST /api/auth/register to mint a fresh JWT for tests, then seed localStorage bfg_token + bfg_user before opening /demo-trade. Right price scale is the right ~60px strip of [data-testid=trade-chart]. Non-empty pixel counting on the largest canvas is a reliable proxy for candle scale changes.
rca of the issue: N/A - all 3 requested changes work as intended.
